rows:
الاتصال بالتحكم المسئول واستلام تصريح العمل مع إلغاء نظام إعادة التوصيل 
 التلقائى للدائرة المراد العام عليها فى حالة فصلها أثناء العمل

اختار
 اتجاه زاوية ضخ المياه وتحديد موقع السيارة بحيث لا
 يصل الماء الملوث إلى عازل 
 ملوث أو يرتد إلى أفراد طقم العمل

ركب
 الأرضى الحملى إلى أرضى البرج بعد تنظيف منطقة التلامس

قم 
 بتسوير 
 منطقة العمل حول السيارة والبرج 
 ووضع لافتات الحذير

تنزيل 
 الركائز الجانبية للسيارة وملاحظة اتزان السيارة ( يفضل وضع قطع خشب أكبر من 
 مساحة الركائز أسفلها حتى لا تنغرس فى الأرض )

اختبار 
 الدوران والرفع للتلسكوب وطلمبة المياه ومستوى الضغط بها وقياس معامل التوصيل 
 للمياه الموجوده بالتنك والتأكد أن داخل الحدود 
 المسموح 
 بها

نبدأ 
 فى رفع التلسكوب إلى مستوى يقترب من منتصف سلسلة العازلات للفيزه السفلى

يتم توجيه البشبورى إلى إحدى جانبى العازل مرموزاً له وتفتح المياه لملاحظة قوى 
 ضخ الطلمبه

يوجه البشبورى بالمياه إلى أول عازل جهة السلك وتثبت المياه فتره فى هذا الوضع 
 حتى يتم التأكد من نظافته جيداً

يرفع البشبورى إلى العازل الثانى مع ملاحظة أن تكون حركة النقل خفيفه وناعمه 
 وتثبت المياه عليها فتره حتى تتأ كد من نظافته

يرفع البشبورى إلى العازل الثالث ثم الرابع ثم الخامس إلى أخر السلسله 
ثم 
يوجه
 البشبورى بعيداً عن العازل وتغلق المياه

يرفع 
 التلسكوب إلى قرب منتصف الفيزه الوسطى 
وتكرر الخطوات من 8 حتى 
11
يرفع التلسكوب إلى الفيزه الثالثه وتكرر الخطوات من 8 حتى 11

يخفض 
 التلسكوب 
وتنقل السياره إلى الدائره الأخرى وتكرر الخطوات من 2 حتى 13
إنزال التلسكوب ثم رفع الأرضى والتسوير

إبلاغ 
 التحكم 
 بأن الخط جاهز للتوصيل

rows: Maintenance Procedure Information System
Overhead lines
Maintenance procedures
Document number: TL-Option 02a
Equipment: Overhead lines, 220 kV
Issued to: Networks
Status: First draft
Date approved:
Procedure: Live-line washing of vertical suspension insulators
Next review date:

sections_en.text: This draft was prepared by Eng. Abdel Hady, from the Extra High Voltage Sector, Greater Cairo.

rows: All members of the work crew must be fully familiar with all parts of the truck and how to operate and control it
Make absolutely sure that all bolts and pins are in their places and do not obstruct normal movement during work
Make sure that all parts move smoothly and normally, without strange noises
Make sure the water tank is clean before filling it with water.
Make sure the resistivity of the water used is within the permitted limits
Check the hydraulic oil level in the tank. Make sure the earthing connections are sound
Test the outriggers, the telescopic boom and the water jet
Make sure the quantity of water in the tank is enough to carry out the required work
Wind speed and direction must be determined
The truck must always be considered energised, even while working on isolated circuits

items: Washing truck, whose telescopic boom maximum height must be greater than the suspension level of the upper phase
A mobile water tank for refilling the truck
Local earthing, wind speed and direction measuring device
PPE and tools for the work crew: waterproof suit, helmet, gloves, insulator and spark-proof goggles
Means of communication between personnel at the sites, and between the control centre and the site
The work area must be fenced off and suitable warning signs posted

sections_en.text: Maintenance steps to be carried out

rows: Contact the responsible control centre and receive the work permit, cancelling the auto-reclosing system of the circuit to be worked on in case it trips during work
Choose the water jet angle and position the truck so that contaminated water does not reach a contaminated insulator or splash back onto the work crew
Connect the local earthing to the tower earthing after cleaning the contact area
Fence off the work area around the truck and the tower and post warning signs
Lower the truck's side outriggers and check the truck's stability (preferably place pieces of wood larger than the outrigger area underneath them so they do not sink into the ground)
Test the rotation and lifting of the telescopic boom, the water pump and its pressure level, and measure the conductivity of the water in the tank, making sure it is within the permitted limits
Start raising the telescopic boom to a level near the middle of the insulator string of the lower phase
Direct the nozzle to one side of the insulator as designated and open the water to observe the pump discharge force
Direct the nozzle with water at the first insulator on the conductor side and hold the water in this position for a while until it is confirmed to be thoroughly clean
Raise the nozzle to the second insulator, taking care that the movement is light and smooth, and hold the water on it for a while until it is confirmed clean
Raise the nozzle to the third insulator, then the fourth, then the fifth, to the end of the string, then direct the nozzle away from the insulator and shut off the water
Raise the telescopic boom to near the middle of the middle phase and repeat steps 8 to 11
Raise the telescopic boom to the third phase and repeat steps 8 to 11
Lower the telescopic boom, move the truck to the other circuit and repeat steps 2 to 13
Lower the telescopic boom, then remove the earthing and the fencing
Inform the control centre that the line is ready for energisation

Document number: TL-Option 02a | Equipment: Overhead lines, 220 kV
Issued to: Networks
Status: First draft
Date approved: | Procedure: Live-line washing of vertical suspension insulators

Introduction
This draft was prepared by Eng. Abdel Hady, from the Extra High Voltage Sector, Greater Cairo.
Safety precautions
All members of the work crew must be fully familiar with all parts of the truck and how to operate and control it
Make absolutely sure that all bolts and pins are in their places and do not obstruct normal movement during work
Make sure that all parts move smoothly and normally, without strange noises
Make sure the water tank is clean before filling it with water.
Make sure the resistivity of the water used is within the permitted limits
Check the hydraulic oil level in the tank. Make sure the earthing connections are sound
Test the outriggers, the telescopic boom and the water jet
Make sure the quantity of water in the tank is enough to carry out the required work
Wind speed and direction must be determined
The truck must always be considered energised, even while working on isolated circuits
Tools, instruments and equipment used
Washing truck, whose telescopic boom maximum height must be greater than the suspension level of the upper phase
A mobile water tank for refilling the truck
Local earthing, wind speed and direction measuring device
PPE and tools for the work crew: waterproof suit, helmet, gloves, insulator and spark-proof goggles
Means of communication between personnel at the sites, and between the control centre and the site
The work area must be fenced off and suitable warning signs posted
Maintenance steps to be carried out
Contact the responsible control centre and receive the work permit, cancelling the auto-reclosing system of the circuit to be worked on in case it trips during work | 1.
Choose the water jet angle and position the truck so that contaminated water does not reach a contaminated insulator or splash back onto the work crew | 2.
Connect the local earthing to the tower earthing after cleaning the contact area | 3.
Fence off the work area around the truck and the tower and post warning signs | 4.
Lower the truck's side outriggers and check the truck's stability (preferably place pieces of wood larger than the outrigger area underneath them so they do not sink into the ground) | 5.
Test the rotation and lifting of the telescopic boom, the water pump and its pressure level, and measure the conductivity of the water in the tank, making sure it is within the permitted limits | 6.
Start raising the telescopic boom to a level near the middle of the insulator string of the lower phase | 7.
Direct the nozzle to one side of the insulator as designated and open the water to observe the pump discharge force | 8.
Direct the nozzle with water at the first insulator on the conductor side and hold the water in this position for a while until it is confirmed to be thoroughly clean | 9.
Raise the nozzle to the second insulator, taking care that the movement is light and smooth, and hold the water on it for a while until it is confirmed clean | 10.
Raise the nozzle to the third insulator, then the fourth, then the fifth, to the end of the string, then direct the nozzle away from the insulator and shut off the water | 11.
Raise the telescopic boom to near the middle of the middle phase and repeat steps 8 to 11 | 12.
Raise the telescopic boom to the third phase and repeat steps 8 to 11 | 13.
Lower the telescopic boom, move the truck to the other circuit and repeat steps 2 to 13 | 14.
Lower the telescopic boom, then remove the earthing and the fencing | 15.
Inform the control centre that the line is ready for energisation | 16.
